summary: Tested the free trial (14 days, 200 replies, Pro features except voice-to-voice) and the Khmer tour video, on the backend and frontend. Backend: 9/9 new tests pass (tests/test_iter30_free_trial.py). A new shop's GET /api/billing gives plan=trial, pro=true, voice=false, team=3, limit=200, days_left=14. Notion connect/sync are no longer blocked for trial shops (400 'Connect Notion first' or bad token, not 402). POST /api/voice/test and POST /api/settings/seller-voice return 402 with the 'paid Pro and Business plans' message. Unit test: effective() turns off voice_replies and seller_voice for trial and Starter and keeps them for Pro. An expired trial gives pro=false, voice=false, team=1. Video file checked with ffmpeg: H.264 High 1280x720 + AAC mono, 2:01.96 long, real audio (mean -18 dB), moov at the front (faststart). Served as video/mp4 with 206 range support. Frontend: all landing testids are present. Hero and trial buttons go to /signup. The #video section shows the poster with Khmer captions. The pricing section shows the trial card and the Starter/Pro/Business cards. Signup via the UI leads to the dashboard. nav-tutorial-btn opens tutorial-dialog with the video, and Escape closes it. Billing page shows 'Free trial · 14 days left · 0/200'. AI & voice tab shows pro-lock-voice with the 'paid Pro and Business plans' text. Knowledge tab shows the Notion connect form, not pro-lock-notion. Team tab shows no pro-lock-team. At 390px: no horizontal overflow (scrollWidth 390).

issues: The Video and Pricing nav links are hidden on mobile and there is no mobile menu. The hero 'Watch the video' button partly makes up for this. Low priority.

action_items: Update the stale old tests that now fail because the trial is Pro (expected): test_iter21_billing_refactor.py::TestProGating::test_trial_gated, ::TestRegression::test_team_limit_402_trial and test_iter22_team_security.py::test_team_add_blocked_on_trial (trial team is now 3).
Optional: add a mobile menu or anchor links for Video/Pricing on small screens.
critical_code_review_comments: billing.view/effective/require_voice are correct. replies.py applies effective() before s.voice_replies is used, so trial shops never get TTS voice replies.
Existing shops still on an active trial now get Pro features right away (intended).
test_iter28_fb_lock_billing.py breaks at collection if the REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL env var is not exported (os.environ.get(...).rstrip). The new iter30 test falls back to reading frontend/.env.

Running test_iter21 TestBilling::test_checkout_flow calls KHQR checkout (mode is now 'relay', the test expects 'local'). It was run once by accident in a regression sweep. Exclude it from future runs.
seed_data_creation: Temporary TEST_ shops were created via register/signup and then deleted, along with leftover test_* users from earlier iterations. tour@ and admin@ were not touched.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Playwright's bundled Chromium has no H.264 support, so <video> reports error code 4 there. This is a limitation of the test environment, not an app bug. Check the video with the imageio_ffmpeg binary instead (python -c 'import imageio_ffmpeg;print(imageio_ffmpeg.get_ffmpeg_exe())'). Run pytest with REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL exported.
